required_outputs: Current-main H0.0 scaffold with the historical R1 execution ledger retained as evidence only
Phase-independent active Work Order evidence/review isolation

design_brief.problem_statement: The prior H0.0 implementation and evidence were created from main 790fd79f, while canonical main was 40c117bb when R2 started. Continuing after later main movement would violate epoch freshness.
design_brief.current_behavior: The historical R2 branch contains the refreshed scaffold and reviewed scope-isolation repair, but canonical main advanced to registry generation 67 before final H0.0 verification completed.
design_brief.desired_behavior: A fresh current-main H0.0 epoch transfers only the proven R2 implementation capability, not R2 execution authorization evidence, and re-runs exact-head verification against the new canonical base.
alternatives_considered: Treat registry-only movement as automatically ignorable.
Invalidate R2 fail-closed and refresh the bounded H0 capability onto current main.
design_brief.selected_design: R2 is terminal historical evidence after main movement. A fresh epoch must start from current main and selectively transfer only implementation capability while keeping R1/R2 execution ledgers historical.
design_brief.why_selected: This preserves exact epoch identity and prevents stale registry/control assumptions from authorizing H0_0_SCAFFOLD_READY.
non_goals: No rewrite of historical H0 R1/R2 events
expected_risks: Copying historical execution ledgers into a fresh epoch
Losing the reviewed scope-isolation fixes during refresh
validation_plan: Create a fresh current-main H0 epoch.
Transfer only implementation/test/validation capability from R2 implementation head 905f0d7d.
Keep R1 and R2 execution ledgers historical-only.
Run fresh unit, Status/Plan/Resume, clean-clone and PC0 evidence before checkpoint proposal.
